notes.title: Dev Update #10
notes.notes:
v0.13 is about 75% complete, and will be releasing between early-to-mid September!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741170/940e3efedcffe95952f2b26a68212f771dba5b70.jpg"]

During your date with Valerie, you'll experience an amusing situation as Valerie mistakes a portly man for an ogre. There's a lot she still doesn't understand about this world... and she is, after all, quite the troublemaker.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741170/76925b9bdb4df64b178f41ba977dbe058e98d853.jpg"]

This update also utilizes the narrator's voice (third-person) more often, particularly during Rena's fight scene. I've had a lot of fun writing these parts, since they allow me to expand on the lore and fight mechanics in real-time. 

Since these parts take more time to write, I'll continue using the narrator voice in moderation going forward.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741170/d41a415acf9c44115fc02393f7080beba9e84aee.jpg"]

With the release of v0.13, Act 3 will become the longest story arc so far. After this, there will be two more updates before the arc wraps up, so I'm expecting it will be the largest overall of the 8 planned acts. Much of the character development and emotional payoff will happen here.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741170/8e0295d3b45832c4e3c1b2784f9fa7db4c2adf99.jpg"]

I hope you enjoy playing v0.13 in just a few weeks! Thank you for reading this dev update, and for supporting Rebel Duet.

notes.title: Dev Update #9
notes.notes:
v0.13 is now halfway complete! I plan to release it by the end of August, though there's a chance it could fall into early September depending on how smoothly the writing process continues.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741170/4f1584f140979c28d04c94d6caf8633862b8b2ea.jpg"]

During your date with Valerie, you'll be able to deepen your bond with your succubus partner. While most of Act 3 has focused on the other heroines, this date brings the spotlight back to Valerie.

In terms of sexual content, this date will also provide the opportunity for something a little different— namely, getting frisky with Valerie in a public place. Will you give in to the thrill of potentially being seen or heard?

During your time together, you and Valerie will also run into a familiar face: Mira. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741170/e9aeb12b0bb656d75f31730173811bcdef6f8f07.jpg"]

While the date is filled with light-hearted fun, the rest of v0.13 takes a considerably more serious tone. The protagonist, Valerie, and Rena are forced to depart their home and confront a familiar threat. 

To survive, the three of you must fight together and devise a strategy to take down an enemy far more powerful than any you've encountered so far.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741170/5030e2df472660eb3fcc4a9ef9bf46455ade18fd.jpg"]

Towards the end of v0.13, you and Valerie sit down for a heart-to-heart conversation. This is one of the few times Valerie truly opens up and shares her raw, unfiltered emotions. 

What happened in Valerie's past? Has her thirst for revenge faded, or has it merely taken a backseat for the time being? These questions—and more— will be answered in v0.13.

Thank you for reading this devlog, and for supporting Rebel Duet! I'll have one more devlog to share before the v0.13 release. I hope you'll enjoy playing it soon.

notes.title: Dev Update #8
notes.notes:
Development for the next major update (v0.13) is underway and proceeding smoothly! I expect it will be released faster than usual— potentially before the end of the summer— but I'll be sure to keep everyone updated as development progresses.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741170/83c47387efd142538016bce9c9c6b31a0dad5864.jpg"]
At the start of v0.13, you'll have the opportunity to go on a date with Valerie before Rena's attack begins. This will include both romantic and sexual content, and will serve as the last big slice-of-life section of Act 3.  


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741170/8cd99e57dcfc9064bb0e698a1f62b3674c293a69.jpg"]
Naturally, this update includes a lot of action, as Rena begins her assault on the vampire nests. However, it won't be an easy task for her, as the nests are guarded by a powerful foe.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741170/b86ec5f9bb225c0b7da42ae232273f02909545a2.jpg"]

This assault kicks off the main phase of Act 3, pushing the story into heavier and more emotionally charged territory. Valerie receives important character development, which directly connects to the protagonist's personal arc in the following update. 

Towards the end of v0.13, players will have the option for another sex scene with Valerie. Unlike previous scenes, this one is designed to be different in tone, as it will be more romantic than sexual. Although Rena's and Annestria's scenes have already featured romantic dialogue, I felt it was the right time for players to develop a stronger emotional bond with Valerie as well. 

Thank you for reading this progress update, and for supporting Rebel Duet! I'll have more details to share in the next dev update.

notes.title: v0.12 Release
notes.notes:
v0.12 of Rebel Duet is now live!


This version advances the story by three full in-game days. It includes six new adult scenes (three male, three female): Annestria, Rena, and a unique scene for the sharing route.

This update took a bit longer than expected, but I hope the quality of content will make up for it. Apologies for the wait and thanks to everyone for your patience.

I hope you enjoy playing it! Please feel welcome to share your thoughts and suggestions, as well as any bugs you might encounter.


Patch Notes (v0.12)
604 new images.

22000 new words of dialogue.

2 new animations.

4 new pieces of music.

3 new map events accessible on Day 25.

3 new Steam achievements.

Added an hourglass icon next to map events that are time-sensitive.

Changed the first name of a side character (now 'Julian').

Fixed a bug that displayed two hairstyle or clothing preferences if one was selected before the in-game choice.

notes.title: Dev Update #7
notes.notes:
v0.12 is planned for release in about a week! I'm aiming to have it ready before the end of this month, but it could slip into the first week of June due to the addition of a new ending scene and some recent personal events that set me back a few days.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741170/51d462799156b85428028ab7ac5b31cc0f9107aa.jpg
This update adds 6 new story sex scenes (three for male MC, three for female MC). 

I'd like to include more training scenes for Valerie in v0.12, but since the update has already taken longer than expected, there's a chance these might get pushed to the next version. The training system will also see a more substantial overhaul in v0.14 and v0.15.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741170/cad2adead22b657cdfbdd3f86ec456dfffb5812e.jpg
You'll likely notice an improvement in render quality in this update. I've been experimenting with more cinematic styles of lighting, and I think the result is quite nice overall. 

Since Act 3 has a darker tone than previous story arcs, I wanted the visuals to better reflect this in certain scenes. Over time, the game's visual style should evolve even further.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741170/b2dea1274e439136893c06719cb5d7c5742f562d.jpg
Once v0.12 is out, my goal is to release the next update several weeks sooner so that I can complete Act 3 (and get started on Act 4) before the end of the year.

Thank you for reading this dev update. I'm very happy with the way v0.12 is turning out, and I hope you'll enjoy playing it!

notes.title: Dev Update #6
notes.notes:
v0.12 is now about 75% complete! It will be released in May, hopefully in a couple of weeks, but possibly towards the end of the month. 

I was originally aiming for a late April release, but I felt it was more important to focus on the quality and length of content.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741170/70a1d165e469606fb44931259cd6bb8f6dc76c5f.jpg
This update has significantly expanded in scope and size. The first in-game day of v0.13 has been added to v0.12, which includes the Rena date, her second set of sex scenes, and several other key moments in between. 

Similar to the cottage sex scene, Rena's second sex scene will be more romantic in nature. I've also moved its placement from morning to night, as I felt this would give the scene much more emotional weight and meaning.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741170/db6eac1c2a59f2568e49d470c0177a20aab6cc1d.jpg
A new side heroine briefly appears in this update. She will play an important role in the story of Act 4, and your choices in a previous story arc will also affect your relationship with her.

Between Valerie, Rena, and Ann as the main heroines, and Mira, Ellania, and this new character as the side heroines, I feel there's now a solid cast of love interests. Aside from these six, there will of course be plenty of other women the MC can have flings or one-night stands with.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741170/e32365575d119944ec74b21025767fa236c13f61.png
If you allowed Valerie to play with women (either the open-harem or sharing routes), there will be a special scene where Annestria recounts a recent encounter with Valerie. 

In the future, you will have the option of letting the two girls get more intimate with each other. For this update, though, the MC will have the honors of making love to Ann first.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741170/02dbe0a6e21997a6207afc27dd4be8e62dd236c3.jpg
From v0.13, we'll be entering the second and more dramatic half of Act 3, where the game's slow build-up finally brings the story and its themes together.

Thank you for reading this dev update. I hope you will enjoy playing v0.12 when it releases next month. I'll be posting one final dev update for v0.12 as the release approaches.

notes.title: Dev Update #5
notes.notes:
v0.12 is now over halfway complete! It's currently planned for release by the end of this month, although there's a chance it could slip into early May, depending on bugs or if extra content gets added.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741170/ca5ecfd203afd9834624af34433e95fe79fb2b68.jpg
In this update, you'll be able to ask Valerie a number of personal questions. For example, how do succubi give birth? Do succubi view humans as equals, or merely a source of energy? Can they survive on just food, and what happens if they go without sex for too long? 

Even more importantly, Valerie and the protagonist will discuss their plans for the future. After all, their quest could eventually lead them outside Rothagen— and into lands further beyond.

Of course, if you aren't interested in these bits of succubi lore, you can choose to end the conversation at any time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741170/4b61b49c2f093d94120cbcc17e8230d694b32010.jpg
If you've been looking forward to more Rena content, you're in luck. The protagonist and Rena will go out for a date while Valerie works an early shift. This scene plays a big role in the overall story, but it is also a great chance to deepen your bonds with your witch friend.

The Rena date was originally planned for v0.13, but I felt it was a better fit for this update. Depending on time available, I may also include the second Rena sex scene, which otherwise is scheduled for v0.13.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741170/c74c257e5abcec9db07a608585e43a26f9b2fb6d.jpg
The protagonist seeks out Captain Gerard for details about the recent attacks. As a result of Oruth's downfall, the Captain also reveals some big changes to Rothagen. While this conversation provides some closure, your actions at the end of Act 2 will still play a major role in the events of Act 4.

For players on the Sharing Route, there will also be some spicy new content in v0.12. I'll have more to share regarding this soon.

As always, thank you for reading this dev update and for supporting Rebel Duet. I hope you look forward to playing v0.12.

notes.title: Dev Update #4
notes.notes:
The next major update (v0.12) is now approximately 30-35% complete! You can expect to play v0.12 sometime in April.

I've decided to adjust the order of some events for the next few updates. Previously, I planned for the flashback of the protagonist's past to be the main focus of v0.12, but I felt this would be a better fit for later in Act 3. Instead, the next two updates will continue to focus on the romance, adult content, and vampire storyline— much like v0.11.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741170/67f362072b700596c9f9f779f7e85a0ea9a3ba88.jpg
Your cute elf friend - Annestria - will come to visit again in this update. This time, however, you and Ann will be alone at home.

Now that your relationship with her has taken a romantic turn, you'll have the choice to make love to Ann in your bedroom. Of course, if you'd prefer to save this special moment for later on (or otherwise wish to just stay friends), you can hold back in this scene and pursue her at a later time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741170/f7673359bfc71482e7c0d6ec672bca2688b60216.jpg
Ann's sister, Ellania, has fully recovered and will now start appearing more frequently in the story. 

I've decided to give Ellania shorter hair to help distinguish her from Ann. Though she isn't a main heroine like Ann, there will be a few sex scenes with her later in the story, including some threesome fun with the two elven sisters.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741170/d8a97418095f39a56d7f70686e83b7c793bf3ffd.jpg
Meanwhile, the vampire threat in Rothagen is brewing in the shadows, and the player will set out to cautiously investigate their encounter with the monster. Be careful, though, because investigating too deeply at this stage could have deadly consequences.
_

The v0.11b patch, which includes new training scenes and minor improvements, will now be combined with the v0.12 release. This is mainly due to some personal events which made releasing a smaller patch a bit tricky. My apologies for the slight change in plans.

Thank you for reading this dev update, and for supporting Rebel Duet! The next dev update will be posted in 2-3 weeks. I hope you look forward to it.

notes.title: v0.11 Release
notes.notes:
v0.11 of Rebel Duet is now live!

This version adds the map feature and advances the story by two full in-game days. Please note that some of the new content can be missable depending on your choices, such as a major adult scene in the tavern exclusive to the sharing route.

A smaller content update (v0.11b) will likely also be released in about a week. This will bring new training positions, improvements, and possibly other changes depending on feedback.

I hope you enjoy it! Please feel welcome to share your thoughts and suggestions, as well as any bugs you might encounter.

Patch Notes (v0.11)

 450 new images.
 17000 new words of dialogue.
 15 new animations.
 2 new pieces of music.
 Added the Map System, which first appears in the new v0.11 story content.
 Added settings option to change the training music.
 Added settings option to change your preferred clothing style for Rena.
 Added Valerie's relationship status to the stats screen, indicating which of the three routes is active.
 Several new lines of text for a virgin MC in the Rena and Act 2 prostitute scenes.
 Several new lines of text for an MC who commits to Valerie but later chooses to make love to Rena.
 Changed the look of the textbox and stats button.

notes.title: v0.11 Release Date
notes.notes:
Hey, quick update to let everyone know v0.11 is releasing on Feb 15th (Saturday)!

Depending on your timezone, this may reach into the early hours of the 16th. While I'm not too sure about the exact timing, I expect it to be made playable between morning and afternoon, Pacific Time.

This is a little bit later than originally planned, due to the addition of extra content. I've added a new ending scene, expanded two of the scenes, and created 15 new animations— including some for the Act 3 Rena scene which previously wasn't animated.

Looking ahead, I expect v0.12 will follow around late April. This will be a lengthier update, featuring less branching options, and focusing more on the protagonist's past and their relationship with Valerie.

I hope you enjoy playing v0.11! I'm looking forward to hearing your thoughts and suggestions. Thank you so much for your patience, and for supporting Rebel Duet. ❤️

notes.title: Dev Update #3
notes.notes:
The next major update—v0.11— is nearing completion! As previously announced, the update will launch on Steam sometime between late this month to early February.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741170/61a5f5d5a67f54bafd5a9bce2c8f309e36b8fdd5.jpg
In this update, Valerie and Rena invite the MC out for a special outing. During the date, they buy a new outfit for the MC as a gift, and spend some time eating and drinking together at the tavern. 

While the two still can't resist bickering with each other, this scene highlights how much friendlier their relationship has become. Combined with the Ann + Rena event, this update is designed to make the character dynamic feel more like a team— and if you so choose, your very own harem.

This scene also includes a new outfit for Valerie, with her hairstyle being determined by your preference.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741170/0e490b9db52b66ec8329fc6a3df8ef880a0a16f8.jpg
If you've chosen the sharing route, there will be a special scene where Valerie reports on her activities at the tavern. You'll have the option to let her tease you or instead take a dominant position.

This choice will influence future sharing events, determining whether Valerie adopts a more submissive role or takes the lead. I thought it was important to include this choice, as players might have a preference for one dynamic over the other.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741170/dd30842c7a1950270ce7186b02521e65424f0b74.jpg
This update also marks the introduction of the map system, which allows players to (optionally) spend their free time with a character or event of their choosing. This first iteration includes a total of five different events, split across two time periods (Morning & Afternoon). 

While I expect most players will choose the heroine events on their first playthrough, several side events have been included to flesh out the world and foreshadow future developments. These events provide opportunities for me to explore side characters, offering scenes that aren't essential to the main story but which may still be of interest to those who wish to dive deeper into the world of Uldreza.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741170/2bc3e1d428821f6b667c1d507fab6baa0621af3a.jpg
Last week, I upgraded to a new work computer with significantly more powerful hardware. There were some limitations in the past (such as the number of characters that could be rendered in a single scene), which are no longer an issue now that I have much more VRAM to work with.

There's some other improvements and features I've been cooking up, some of which will be ready for this update. I've been listening to all the feedback so far and am committed to making Rebel Duet even better throughout its Early Access period.

I hope you enjoy playing v0.11 when it launches in just a few weeks. Thank you so much for reading this post and for supporting Rebel Duet!

notes.title: Dev Update #2
notes.notes:
Development for the next major update (v0.11) is now halfway complete! It is expected to release around mid-late January, although there's a slight chance it could release in the first few days of February, depending on bugs encountered during playtesting.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741170/7ba0846ee5f924dd0db82c55b11c08560348ea7b.jpg
In one of the new v0.11 scenes, Annestria will arrive at the door to say hello. This will allow you to further bond with her, learn more about her recent activities and elven culture, and even kiss her—should you wish to romance your new elven friend.

This scene will also see Annestria and Rena being introduced to each other for the first time, since Rena is home. With them now acquainted, the doors will be opened for more content involving them together, as well as all three main heroines (Valerie / Rena / Ann) at once. 

For example, perhaps in the future you might like to invite Valerie and Ann to bed for some threesome fun? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741170/e6798edf73d04b6a13e49918a888359bd8515541.jpg
If you opted into the sharing route, Valerie will have the opportunity to get friendly with a tavern patron by sharing a drink. This character can be either female or male depending on your choices, and players will get to decide how far Valerie might go for tips.

Naturally, this scene will not occur if you chose either the monogamy or open-harem route.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741170/d952af8af6f8bc3cffa0dcdac41845d5ea38bf18.jpg
Of course, things are not all peace and quiet. The protagonist will have their first encounter with a new type of enemy. Since the protagonist has become more powerful, they will be able to fight this threat themselves without the help of Valerie. However, there might be consequences for these actions later on.
_

I hope you enjoyed the second dev update for Rebel Duet. A third update will be posted after the new year. I also expect v0.12 will be released more quickly than v0.11, since there won't be any time off from development like there is with the holiday season.

I wish everyone a wonderful Christmas and New Year! If you have any feedback, please feel free to share your thoughts in the forums or the Discord server. Thank you for reading.

notes.title: Dev Update #1
notes.notes:
Development on the next major update of Rebel Duet (v0.11) is progressing smoothly, with an estimated release in January.

This update is planned to introduce a new gameplay feature: the map system.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741170/6f552268e67bf91bddca738206474f89193f4492.jpg
Every few in-game days, you will be given two free periods in which you can interact with characters and events of your choosing. This allows you to forge deeper bonds with the heroines (including romances), obtain new training items, as well as engage in special adult scenes.

While this system is still a work-in-progress, the above image should give a rough idea of what to expect. I felt it was important to give players more freedom, while making sure not to impact the pacing of the game. Much like the training system, you can also choose to 'skip time' if you'd rather just move forward with the story.

v0.11 also includes a bunch of new story content, including a new encounter with Mira, optional scenes for Valerie at the tavern, a sudden attack from a mysterious creature, and much more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741170/6baed6d581e20f128d6fc49b752151c99f6d4cae.jpg
As thanks for defeating Oruth at the end of Act 2, Mira will also offer the player an 'intimate' reward. Will you accept her temptations?
_

I hope you enjoyed the first dev update for Rebel Duet! If you have any suggestions or feedback, please feel free to share them on the forums or in the Discord server—I’d love to hear from you.

Thank you so much for your incredible support so far. I'll continue to do my best to bring you exciting new updates and content.
